questions.stem: The glossopharyngeal nerve is transected accidentally during a surgical procedure in a 45-year-old male. Which of the following is most likely lost in his patient?
questions.stemHtml: The glossopharyngeal nerve is transected accidentally during a surgical procedure in a 45-year-old male. Which of the following is most likely lost in his patient?

options.label: A
options.text: Taste sensation from the anterior two-thirds of the tongue

options.label: B
options.text: General sensation from the tonsillar lining

options.label: C
options.text: Salivary secretion from the submandibular gland
